ideas.pitch: An AI tool that takes historical fading Kannada inscriptions, enhances the text using vision models, and translates epigraphical Kannada into modern readable scripts with audio storytelling.
ideas.problem_statement: Promoting Karnataka's rich culture, heritage, and regional development through digital solutions.
ideas.title: KannadaKriti AI Heritage Restorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets judges' pride in Karnataka's deep epigraphical history with a working computer vision and LLM demo, following the pattern of impactful multimodal AI winners.

ideas.pitch: A localized voice-first agent that helps travelers navigate lesser-known heritage sites in Karnataka while teaching local Kannada slang and dialect variations.
ideas.problem_statement: Promoting Kannada language, Karnataka's tourism, and regional development.
ideas.title: NudiNavi: Voice-First Kannada Tourism & Dialect Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves regional tourism discovery gaps with an interactive voice interface, matching the agentic execution patterns seen in successful hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A geo-tagged mobile web platform connecting traditional rural artisans of Karnataka directly to urban buyers with automated Kannada copy generation for product listings.
ideas.problem_statement: Promoting Karnataka's culture, heritage, and regional economic development.
ideas.title: JanapadaSetu: Karnataka Folk Art & Artisan Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides clear measurable economic impact for local artisans, addressing real regional development priorities that judges care about deeply.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web app that evaluates school students' written Kannada grammar in real-time, providing constructive feedback and gamified quizzes based on Karnataka state curriculum.
ideas.problem_statement: Promoting Kannada language and education through digital solutions.
ideas.title: KannadaShikshaka Adaptive Grammar Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly benefits local students and educational institutions hosting the hackathon (NIE Mysuru), hitting close to home for the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight routing dashboard designed for rural Karnataka transit networks that optimizes emergency vehicle paths and local KSRTC bus tracking using open maps data.
ideas.problem_statement: Regional development and infrastructure improvement across Karnataka.
ideas.title: NammaRoute: Rural Karnataka Emergency & Transport Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven emergency routing concepts into a hyper-local context, offering a tangible utility for regional infrastructure.
